sourceScope: Locally modified incoming handoff ownership and its tests; hashes identify the tested candidate. Unrelated preview tooling work ran concurrently outside these paths.
commands: NODE_PATH=/Users/oleksandr.mekhovov/work/my_projects/go_test/authoring/fpv-worlds/node_modules node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='native boot completes|native incoming Solo handoff|incoming Solo (retires|awaits)' game/test/mission-library-return-intent-host.test.mjs
behaviorVerified: Focus and hidden retirement finish public boot readiness before the held mission metadata request settles.
Late metadata success and rejection cannot launch, reopen the chooser, replace the run message, steal focus, or change saved player settings.
Focus retirement finishes readiness while the real presentation response and boot picture remain pending.
Late shared picture completion retains the exact paused run checkpoint and newer focus; a later explicit Missions opening still works.
Without retirement, the held picture keeps boot interactive; completing it reaches the exact requested mission at tick zero and paused briefing.
Existing successful exact Team-to-Solo handoff still requires explicit Start.
limitations: Five selected host cases passed; thirteen other cases in that file were not selected and are not claimed as rerun.
No browser, build, global lint, or replay qualification was run for this narrow change.
This fixes ownership retirement, not the separately observed WebKit source-preview synchronous Team catalogue compilation delay.
Shared metadata/picture work remains owned by its original producer; this change neither cancels native in-flight work nor suppresses current cosmetic failure reporting.
